# One segment workspace

Continue: Source = last accepted segment.
Reroll accepted: Source = target parent; the second Load is enabled automatically; select latest accepted chain. Blank target selects its head.
New scene: fresh generation without old frame anchors.
Reanchor: the image loader is enabled automatically; select the new first frame; starts a fresh FL2VA scene without old AV context. Rerolling it requires the anchor again.

Changing action mutes unused bundled helper loaders. For a reroll of a reanchored shot, enable its image loader manually (Ctrl+M) if needed. Match the diffusion model to the actual task family (FL2VA for Reanchor). Draft can be repeated; Accept commits. Continue from this result updates Source and returns to Draft.

Reroll invalidates later segments. New scene / Reanchor start separate shots: use Video Stitch between shots, Latent Stitch within continuous shots.
